# Samsung Announces Another Galaxy Event on August 27

 Laurent Giret
 Aug 20, 2026
 0

Samsung announced another Galaxy event on August 27, which will be live-streamed on the company’s YouTube Channel at 8 AM ET. This is coming a little more than a month after the company’s Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22, where the new Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8 foldable phones were revealed.
